description: MatchEngine complete step-by-step match scenarios for state and event verification

scenarios.name: 2-0 Clean Win (P1 wins)
scenarios.description: P1 wins round 1 by opponent timeout, wins round 2, match finishes 2-0.

scenarios.name: 0-2 Clean Win (P2 wins)
scenarios.description: P2 wins both rounds by P1 timeout, match finishes 0-2.

scenarios.name: 2-1 Contested Match
scenarios.description: P1 wins round 1, P2 wins round 2, P1 wins round 3 (decider).

scenarios.name: Consecutive Exhausted Draws
scenarios.description: Rounds draw when all question answers are exhausted.

scenarios.name: 1-1 and 3rd Round Draw
scenarios.description: Score is 1-1, round 3 draws due to exhausted answers; match continues.

scenarios.name: Timeout Round End Starter
scenarios.description: Starter P1 makes no move and times out; P2 wins round.

scenarios.name: Timeout Round End Non-Starter
scenarios.description: P1 answers correctly, P2 non-starter times out; P1 wins round.

scenarios.name: Dual Timeout Across Rounds
scenarios.description: P2 times out in round 1; P1 times out in round 2.

scenarios.name: All Answers Exhausted Instant Draw
scenarios.description: Both players guess all 6 answers of q1; round immediately draws.

scenarios.name: Forfeit in Active Round
scenarios.description: P1 leaves during active round; P2 wins match immediately.

scenarios.name: Forfeit Between Rounds
scenarios.description: P2 forfeits during roundEnded phase; P1 wins match.

scenarios.name: Forfeit After Match Finished
scenarios.description: Calling forfeit after match is already finished is ignored.

scenarios.name: Forfeit Freezes Score
scenarios.description: P1 led 1-0 in round 1, then P1 forfeits in round 2; score freezes at 1-0, P2 wins.

scenarios.name: Double Forfeit
scenarios.description: Two consecutive forfeit calls on the same tick; second is ignored.

scenarios.name: Near Miss Quota Depletion
scenarios.description: P1 uses 1 near miss (quota 1); next near miss yields WrongAnswer with hintShown=false.

scenarios.name: Near Miss Hidden From Opponent
scenarios.description: Near miss attempts are hidden from opponent in visibleAttempts.

scenarios.name: Turn Alternation on Correct Answer
scenarios.description: P1 answers correctly; turn passes to P2 and deadline resets to nowMs + 15s.

scenarios.name: Wrong Answer Keeps Turn
scenarios.description: Wrong answer emits WrongAnswer event, turn stays with current player, deadline unchanged.

scenarios.name: Empty Answer Rejected
scenarios.description: Empty or whitespace input emits Ignored("empty_input"), turn does not change.

scenarios.name: Repeated Answer Rejected
scenarios.description: Previously accepted answer emits AlreadySaid event; turn does not change.

scenarios.name: Round Starter Alternation
scenarios.description: Round 1 starter is P1 (index 0); Round 2 starter is P2 (index 1); Round 3 starter is P1.

scenarios.name: Time Bonus Calculation
scenarios.description: Remaining seconds bonus calculation from deadlineMs and submit time.

scenarios.name: Round Starting Ticks
scenarios.description: Ticks during active round advance time without ending round until deadline.

scenarios.name: Round Ending Wait Ticks
scenarios.description: Ticks during roundEnded phase are no-ops; startNextRound initiates next round.

scenarios.name: Rate Limit and Turn Attempts Limit
scenarios.description: Submitting too fast (< 600ms) emits tooFast Ignored event.

scenarios.name: Wrong Player Submit Ignored
scenarios.description: Submitting when it is not player turn emits not_player_turn Ignored event.
